question: Which of the following states does NOT fall under the basin of river Tapi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Tapi River** is a river in central India located to the south of the Narmada river which flows westwards before draining** into the Arabian Sea.**
 
• Tapi River rises in the Gawilgarh Hills of the Deccan plateau in **Madhya Pradesh and then flows westward.**
 
• The river has a length of around** 700 km** and flows through the states of **Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• Other west-flowing rivers are **Narmada, Sabarmati, Mahi, Luni, and Periyar.**
 
• Thus Rajasthan does NOT fall under the basin of river Tapi.
